description:
What is This Part?
This is the Front Drive Shaft, #2 Propeller, that goes from the Transfer Case to the Front Differential
FITS ALL MODELS from 1985 thru 1995.
Large and Small Bolt Pattern Flanges Included.
Simply install the Flange you require on Drive Shaft.
Suzuki OEM Drive Shaft
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Drive Shaft (OEM)
Qty 1 – Small Bolt Pattern Flange 1985 – 1989 (after-market)
Qty 1 – Large Bolt Pattern Flange 1990 – 1995 (after-market)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Small Flange – Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 All Models
Large Flange – Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
